problem_text:
A logistics manager must select packages for a cargo shipment. Available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 8 m³, revenue $283
* Package 2: volume 17 m³, revenue $96
* Package 3: volume 23 m³, revenue $210
* Package 4: volume 2 m³, revenue $283
* Package 5: volume 43 m³, revenue $32
* Package 6: volume 35 m³, revenue $232
* Package 7: volume 44 m³, revenue $66
* Package 8: volume 17 m³, revenue $112
* Package 9: volume 33 m³, revenue $163
* Package 10: volume 48 m³, revenue $53
* Package 11: volume 7 m³, revenue $266
* Package 12: volume 28 m³, revenue $293
* Package 13: volume 23 m³, revenue $101
* Package 14: volume 10 m³, revenue $72
* Package 15: volume 19 m³, revenue $160
* Package 16: volume 12 m³, revenue $258
* Package 17: volume 19 m³, revenue $136
* Package 18: volume 35 m³, revenue $133
* Package 19: volume 5 m³, revenue $254
* Package 20: volume 13 m³, revenue $193
* Package 21: volume 28 m³, revenue $147
* Package 22: volume 21 m³, revenue $62

The cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 343 m³. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package is either fully accepted or rejected.
